examples.purpose: A card the user holds, shown as a picture (no onPress): the bank's 29 px mark and name, then the type at the top, the art strip across the middle, and the masked number, cardholder and expiry at the bottom. The package ships no logo, so the app passes its own; the URI stands for it.
examples.jsx:
<DebitCard
  bankName="JioFinance"
  bankLogoSlot={<Image imageSource={{ uri: 'https://example.com/jiofinance-logo.png' }} width={29} height={29} />}
  cardType="Debit"
  cardNumber="•••• 4821"
  cardholderName="Priya Sharma"
  expireDate="09/29"
/>

from.quote: The bank and the card type sit at the top, the art strip runs across the middle, and the number, cardholder, and expiry fill the bottom.

props.name: cardholderName
props.description: A long name wraps. Declared: Cardholder name displayed in the footer. Default "Shruti Shukla", from the component source.

props.name: cardNumber
props.description: Shown exactly as passed: the card doesn't mask it. Declared: Masked card number. Default "•••• 1234", from the component source.

props.name: expireDate
props.description: Card expiry date. Default "02/28", from the component source.

props.name: bankName
props.description: Shown on one line; long text ends in an ellipsis. Declared: Bank / issuer name shown in the header left. Default "JioFinance", from the component source.

props.name: cardType
props.description: Shown on one line; long text ends in an ellipsis. Declared: Card type label shown in the header right (e.g. "Debit", "Credit") Default "Debit", from the component source.

props.name: cardArtSource
props.description: Left out (undefined), the card shows the package's own strip: 328 × 50, cover, 4 px corners. Declared: Image source for the decorative card art strip. `undefined` uses the bundled strip. Pass `null` (or `showArt={false}`) to hide the art.

props.name: showArt
props.description: showArt={false}, like cardArtSource={null}, drops the art strip; the card stays 224 px tall. Declared: When `false`, hides the art strip. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: bankLogoSlot
props.description: Before bankName, 4 px apart; takes any node and passes it the card's modes. The package ships no logo for it. Declared: Slot: custom content for the bank logo area (left side of header, before bankName text)

props.name: providerLogoSlot
props.description: After cardType, 8 px apart; takes any node and passes it the card's modes. The package ships no network logo for it. Declared: Slot: custom content for the provider logo area (right side of header, after cardType text)

props.name: modes
props.description: Mode configuration for design token resolution.

props.name: style
props.description: The card's size comes from its tokens (328 × 224, radius 16). style goes last and can change the box, but the content doesn't reflow. Declared: Container style overrides.

props.name: onPress
props.description: While pressed the card dims to 0.75 opacity. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the card to 0.5 opacity, with aria-disabled on the web. Declared: Disable interaction and apply the disabled look (with or without `onPress`).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label. Defaults to bank, type, and masked number.

modes.name: DebitCard brand
modes.description: Sets the card's brand colours: JFS gold #cea15a (the default) with #141414 text, or SBI purple #5d00b5 with white text, also when the brand comes from JFSThemeProvider. Declared: A token collection DebitCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: bankLogoSlot
slots.description: Slot: custom content for the bank logo area (left side of header, before bankName text)

slots.name: providerLogoSlot
slots.description: Slot: custom content for the provider logo area (right side of header, after cardType text)

events.name: onPress
events.description: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

gaps.text: The package ships no bank or network logos, where Figma's card shows them; the app passes its own through bankLogoSlot and providerLogoSlot.
The art strip doesn't change with the brand, and there is no brand foreground (text) token.

Figma's Debit Card exposes cardholderName, cardNumber and expireDate as properties; its bank and network logos are nested instances and its brand is a variable mode. In code bankName and cardType are props, and the logos go in bankLogoSlot and providerLogoSlot.
